principle: Truthful parity: MMIR shows what is live, beta, planned, blocked or premium planned without implying paid or unsafe routes are active.

legend.live: Works now in the public/free flow.
legend.beta: Usable foundation exists, with polish or production hardening still needed.
legend.planned: Backlog item exists, but this is not live yet.
legend.blocked: Blocked until safety, identity, policy, cost or backend prerequisites are ready.
legend.premium planned: Commercial path is designed but not enabled without explicit approval.
